_doc: Bannerline maps. Field-local coordinates: x = 0 is the field centre (negative left), z = 0 the gate end, z = length the Keep end (units walk +z). Fields of one match sit side by side along world x, `gap` metres apart. Per mode: field width and gate count (one gate per enemy player). leakZ: a unit reaching it tears banners and leaves. ford: a band across the field that slows walkers by `slow` (flying units ignore it). walls: axis-aligned blockers [x0,z0,x1,z1] (none on vale yet; per-gate lane walls arrive with 2v2/3v3 in M6). Read by js/sim/map.js. lanes (team modes, PLAN §4.2): one lane per gate for the first `wallTo` metres, split by walls `thickness` m thick; units can never cross them (each sender's units stay in its lane until the merge), heroes cross at `heroGaps` (z ranges). keep.guard: the Keep shoots (js/sim/keep.js): every `every` s it splashes `damage + damagePerMinute x minutes` on enemy bodies within `splash` m of the one nearest the leak line inside `range` m of the Keep.
